searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline version crashed on a None field; work/comps.py also not usable, so I used the Gowans API directly) for moulding planes, plough plane, tray planes; Gowans API moulding+planes and plough+plane; WebSearch armitage site (no useful hits), WebSearch general moulding/plough planes (snippets only, no prices for Carters). Carters plough/moulding category pages are the best Australian source but returned 429. eBay sold (Closed) would help: needs Chrome.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'wooden moulding planes lot' and 'sliding arm plough plane brass'; also Carters sold lots categories planes-moulding and planes-plough
viewing_check: Look at the toe/heel ends of every plane for maker stamps (Moseley, Mathieson, Griffiths, Varvill, Sorby, etc). Check the plough plane for a maker stamp, ivory/boxwood or rosewood fittings, and cracks at the fence/arms. Count planes and note any complete matched sets or rare profiles.
